title: Domicile
summary: Domicile connects a person to a state through residence and the legally relevant intention to make it a home. In the readings it matters both to citizenship for diversity and to certain bases of judicial authority.
notes: Mas v. Perry addresses the citizenship inquiry in its particular setting. Corporate and unincorporated-entity citizenship follow different rules.

sections.Meaning: Domicile connects a person to a state through residence and the legally relevant intention to make it a home. In the readings it matters both to citizenship for diversity and to certain bases of judicial authority.
sections.How to work through the question: For diversity, identify the person’s domicile at the relevant time rather than merely a temporary residence or mailing address. Examine the facts bearing on an asserted change and whether the earlier domicile has been displaced.
